description: A utility module for capturing a DOM element as an image and triggering its download, with style copying and canvas content preservation.

methods.name: generateFileStem
methods.description: Creates a filename stem from a description and date.

methods.name: copyAllComputedStyles
methods.description: Copies computed styles from original DOM node to its clone.

methods.name: processCloneForVisibility
methods.description: Adjusts cloned DOM element styles for visibility and layout.

methods.name: preserveCanvasContent
methods.description: Copies canvas content from original to cloned DOM element.

methods.name: createEnhancedClone
methods.description: Creates a styled clone of a DOM element with style and canvas content preserved.

methods.name: downloadAsImageOptimized
methods.description: Main function that captures a DOM element as JPEG and triggers download.
